pattern: 少しも～ない（すこしも～ない）
purpose: Deny even a small degree of a state.
keywords: Even after hearing the explanation, I do not feel reassured at all.
My grandfather has not changed at all.
It is a difficult problem, but not at all boring.
restrictions: Usually negates degree, change, or emotional response.
mistake: Use a negative predicate for “not in the slightest”.

segments.role: Deny even a small degree of a state. 少しも + negative predicate
